reedSaxReedyVibrato.source:
dsp GenReedSaxReedyVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 1.0 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.9, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.6 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

dsp GenReedBassoonSoftStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 1.0 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.6, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

reedBassoonSoftVibrato.source:
dsp GenReedBassoonSoftVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 1.0 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.6, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

reedBassoonBrassyStill.source:
dsp GenReedBassoonBrassyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 1.0 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 1.3, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

reedHarmoniumSoftVibrato.source:
dsp GenReedHarmoniumSoftVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.6, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.55 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

reedAccordionSoftStill.source:
dsp GenReedAccordionSoftStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.6, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.65 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

reedAccordionSoftVibrato.source:
dsp GenReedAccordionSoftVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.6, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.65 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

dsp GenReedAccordionReedyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.9, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.65 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.1495

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]

    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0

    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)

    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 1.3, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.65 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7957

reedMelodicaSoftVibrato.source:
dsp GenReedMelodicaSoftVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.6, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.6 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

dsp GenFm1x1Pad where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.8223

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6775

dsp GenFm1x2PluckFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6475

dsp GenFm1x2PadFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.5463

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>

    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))

    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))

    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))

    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6909

fm1x3Pad.source:
dsp GenFm1x3Pad where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6748

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 0.6 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * 0.5
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6872

fm1x3p5PluckFb.source:
dsp GenFm1x3p5PluckFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 3.5 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6938

    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))

    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))

dsp GenFm2x1Pad where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.7151
